[[/Maps|Non-interactive maps]] | ingame name=Shenzun Tunnels | game link type 0=explorable | game link num 0=197 }} The [[Shenzun Tunnels]] is a part of [[Kaineng City]] that lies close to ground-level, close to the dirty sewage that drains from other parts of the city. It is likely that the extremely poor would reside here, concentrated mostly in the northern areas and in the center. The [[Am Fah]] have a presence here, concentrated mostly on the southwestern and northeastern corners - a result of the [[Afflicted]] having taken over the other parts. ==Getting there== The [[To Tahnnakai Temple]] [[primary quest]] will lead characters through this area for the first time. Travel from [[Senji's Corner]] via the [[Nahpui Quarter (explorable area)|Nahpui Quarter explorable area]] or [[Xaquang Skyway]]. Alternatively, when available leave directly from [[Tahnnakai Temple (outpost)|Tahnnakai Temple]] or [[Sunjiang District (outpost)|Sunjiang District]]. ==Shrines== ;[[Resurrection shrine]]s with a
